manual_fix_note: Added default for 'group_name_prefix' (naming string, no default previously).
Added default for 'vpc_name' (Name tag on a VPC created by this template).
Added default for 'environment' (naming/tag string, no default previously).
Added default for 'api_type' (was missing) and fixed a pre-existing empty-string default on 'name' that failed AWS's length validation.
Added default for 'project' (KMS alias naming) and relaxed an overly-narrow '~> 4.0' AWS provider pin that conflicted with tflocal's modern LocalStack endpoint overrides.

Added default for 'name_prefix' (naming string, no default previously), marked the 'user_pool_client' output sensitive (Terraform now requires this for values containing a Cognito client secret), and flipped 'deletion_protection' default from true to false so the disposable benchmark stack can actually be torn down (same class of fix as the CFN track's Cognito deletion-protection row).

Added default for 'bucket' (naming string, no default previously) and flipped 'use_account_alias_prefix' default from true to false -- LocalStack has no IAM account alias configured by default, so the data source lookup this gates returns empty and fails; disabling the (cosmetic) alias-prefixing behavior avoids the dependency.
Added default for 'org' (an object-typed variable with organization_name/organization_unit/environment_type/environment_name string fields, no default previously).

Added default for 'name' (naming string, no default previously) and relaxed an overly-narrow '~> 4.0' AWS provider pin that conflicted with tflocal's modern LocalStack endpoint overrides (same fix class as terrads_c5f41bfffb0f above).

Added default for 'accountID' (must be exactly 12 digits per the variable's own validation block; used LocalStack's default dummy account id '000000000000') and relaxed an overly-narrow '~> 4.0' AWS provider pin that conflicted with tflocal's modern LocalStack endpoint overrides (same fix class as terrads_c5f41bfffb0f above).
